question: A team scored 81 points. In the first half, 69 points were lost due to fouls. Then 1 more point was lost. They gained 59 points in the second half. Then they doubled their score. Then they doubled again. What is the final score?

Two workers combined 154 tasks. They multiplied the workload by 9 times. Then by 6 times again. They completed 19 tasks. They still had 643 pending tasks. What is the task load they are managing (in combined count)?
Player A had 137 chips. He tripled his chips 3 times in a game. He lost 399 chips. He lost 4 more chips. Then he divided the remainder equally among 4 rounds. What are his chips per round?
A production line started with 202 widgets. They multiplied by 7. Then by 5. They added 40 more widgets. Finally, they tripled the total. How many widgets were produced?

A garden had 163 plants. Production increased 6 times by summer. They added 40 more plants. They multiplied again by 5 for expansion. They added 5 more. How many plants are in the garden (converted to dozens)?

A warehouse started with 231 boxes. They multiplied inventory 7 times by opening a second branch. Then multiplied by 5. Then by 8. They added 53 from returns. They shipped 15,769 boxes to customers. How many boxes remain?

A factory produced 89 units on Monday. Tuesday's production multiplied by 8. They added 10 units from rework. Wednesday output was 332 units. They multiplied Thursday's projection by 7. Then multiplied by 2. Friday they added 42 units. What is the week's total output?

Player A started with 87 tokens. He multiplied by 9 through a power-up. He gained 46 tokens. He lost 595 tokens. He divided the remainder in half. He gained 44 tokens back. He gained 55 more. What are his final tokens?

A library had 235 books. In spring, 162 books were removed for repairs. In summer, 19 books were removed. In fall, 10 more books were removed. By winter, the remaining collection multiplied 6 times. How many books does the library have?

A factory started with 135 workers. They multiplied the workforce 9 times by 2024. Then by 8 times again. They lost 168 workers to attrition. They hired 11 replacements. How many workers does the factory employ?

A factory started with 207 units. They multiplied by 9 through efficiency gains. They lost 64 units to defects. They lost 830 more due to recalls. They added 30 replacement units. How many units remain?

A team started with 144 points. They lost 22 points in penalties. They multiplied by 8 earning bonus points. Then by 6. They lost 1,614 points in a reversal. They lost 1,385 more. They added 37 back. How many points does the team have?

A shop started with 119 items. They multiplied stock by 8. They added 67 items from a donation. They added 23 more. They lost 437 items in a sale. They lost 539 more through damage. How many items remain?

A warehouse had 168 boxes. In the morning, they added 55. By afternoon, they removed 94. By evening, they added 73. They added 5 more overnight. Then 201 were shipped. They had a distractor event involving 8 boxes (which wasn't counted). How many boxes remain?
Two players combined their marbles: 232 total. Player A added 40 more marbles. Both lost 57 marbles. Both lost another 175. Player B added 68 marbles to his half. How many marbles does Player B have?

A sports league started with 37 teams. By adding resources, they multiplied by 7. Then by 6. Then by 6 again. They absorbed a rival league bringing 12,666 more teams. How many teams does the league have?

A factory produced 109 units. Morning production multiplied by 6. Afternoon production multiplied by 8. They added 32 more units from rework. Final output multiplied by 8 again. How many units were produced in total (in terms of conversions)?

A student began with 15 study notes. In week 1, they removed 13 notes (editing). In week 2, they added 75 notes. In week 3, they added 78. In week 4, they added 38. They had to focus on distractor event worth 11 notes (not included). How many study notes total?

A bakery started with 48 pastries. Morning bake added 47. By lunch, they multiplied by 6. Afternoon multiplied by 6 again. They added 22 more fresh pastries. Evening shift multiplied by 9. Night shift multiplied by 6. How many pastries were baked?

A factory produced 217 gadgets. Production multiplied 8 times by January. Production multiplied 4 times more in February. Production multiplied 8 times in March. They added 47 gadgets from defect recovery. How many gadgets were produced?

A warehouse started with 204 boxes. They removed 192 for shipment. They divided the remainder equally among 3 centers. Each center added 79 boxes. Each lost 14 boxes to damage. Each added 6 boxes from returns. Finally, each multiplied by 7 for reorganization. What is the total across all centers?

A team scored 111 points. They added 15 points. They multiplied by 9 for a tournament. They divided by 3 for three divisions. They added 20 points in overtime. They multiplied by 5 for final ranking. What was the final score per division?

A factory had 135 units. They removed 90 for defects. They removed 44 more. They multiplied by 6 for bulk orders. They multiplied by 4 again. They added 11 units. They added 60 more. How many units does the factory have?

A student studied 123 pages. Morning: added 18 pages. Afternoon: added 33 pages. Evening: added 39 pages. Night: added 34 pages. They found a distractor worth 4 pages. How many pages did the student study in total?
A team started with 193 points. They added 30 points. They added 13 points. They removed 26 points. They doubled the total. How many points does the team have?
